arxiv-2208-13239.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Łukasz Kosiński, Nikolai Nikolov. It is proved for a strongly pseudoconvex domain D D in ℂ d \mathbb{C}^{d} with 𝒞 2 , α \mathcal{C}^{2,\alpha} -smooth boundary that any complex geodesic through every two close points of D D sufficiently close to ∂ D \partial D and whose difference is non-tangential to ∂ D \partial D intersect a compact subset of D D that depends only on the rate of non-tangentiality. As an application, a lower bound for the Kobayashi distance is obtained.

arxiv-2309-15233.title: A Highly Efficient and Pure Few-Photon Source on Chip
arxiv-2309-15233.creator: Zhaohui Ma, Jia-Yang Chen, Malvika Garikapati, Zhan Li, Chao Tang, Yong Meng Sua, Yu-Ping Huang
arxiv-2309-15233.description: Abstract We report on multi-photon statistics of correlated twin beams produced in a periodic poled micro-ring resonator on thin-film lithium niobate. Owing to high cavity confinement and near perfect quasi-phase matching, the photons pairs are produced efficiently in single modes at rates reaching 27 MHz per μ \mu W pump power.

arxiv-2503-16759.title: elaTCSF: A Temporal Contrast Sensitivity Function for Flicker Detection and Modeling Variable Refresh Rate Flicker
arxiv-2503-16759.creator: Yancheng Cai, Ali Bozorgian, Maliha Ashraf, Robert Wanat, Rafał K. Mantiuk
arxiv-2503-16759.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yancheng Cai, Ali Bozorgian, Maliha Ashraf, Robert Wanat, Rafał K. Mantiuk. The perception of flicker has been a prominent concern in illumination and electronic display fields for over a century. Traditional approaches often rely on Critical Flicker Frequency (CFF), primarily suited for high-contrast (full-on, full-off) flicker. To tackle varying contrast flicker, the International Committee for Display Metrology (ICDM) introduced a Temporal Contrast Sensitivity Function TCSF IDMS within the Information Display Measurements Standard (IDMS). Nevertheless, this standard overlooks crucial parameters: luminance, eccentricity, and area.

arxiv-2505-20828.title: GET: Goal-directed Exploration and Targeting for Large-Scale Unknown Environments
arxiv-2505-20828.creator: Lanxiang Zheng, Ruidong Mei, Mingxin Wei, Hao Ren, Hui Cheng
arxiv-2505-20828.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lanxiang Zheng, Ruidong Mei, Mingxin Wei, Hao Ren, Hui Cheng. Object search in large-scale, unstructured environments remains a fundamental challenge in robotics, particularly in dynamic or expansive settings such as outdoor autonomous exploration. This task requires robust spatial reasoning and the ability to leverage prior experiences.

arxiv-2509-26361.creator: Jieyun Pan, Tian Long, Ruben Scardovelli, Stéphane Popinet, Stéphane Zaleski
arxiv-2509-26361.description: Abstract The Edge-Based Interface Tracking (EBIT) method is a novel Front-Tracking method where the markers are located on grid edges, and their connectivity is implicitly represented by a color vertex field. This localized representation simplifies the process of topology changes and allows for almost automatic parallelization.

pmc-10517425.title: Complementary and Alternative Medicine Use Among Patients With Diabetes Mellitus in Saudi Arabia: A Community-Based Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-10517425.creator: Khaled A Yaghmour, Raneem Abu Sadi, Ftoon Badroun, Rezan Alali, Fatimah Almubarak, Zainab Alabbad, Noura Alharthi, Jamil A Samkari, Mahmoud A Gaddoury
pmc-10517425.description: Background: Global studies have observed a disparity in the use of complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) among diabetic patients.Objectives: To estimate the prevalence, types, and correlates of CAM use among patients with diabetes mellitus (DM) in Saudi Arabia.Methodology: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 1290 Saudis with type 2 DM aged ≥18 years.

pmc-11679205.title: Development of Test Cases for Automated Vehicle Driving Safety Assessment Using Driving Trajectories
pmc-11679205.creator: Woori Ko, Minkyu Shim, Sangmin Park, Soomok Lee, Ilsoo Yun, George Yannis
pmc-11679205.description: For consumers to have confidence in the safety of automated vehicles (AVs), AVs must be assessed using systematically developed scenarios to verify driving safety and reliability. In particular, verification using scenarios has been widely performed for the assessment and certification of AVs. This study aims to develop test cases based on driving trajectories to assess the driving safety of AVs.

pmc-12418861.title: Digital speech assessments and machine learning for differentiation of neurodegenerative diseases
pmc-12418861.creator: Kyurim Kang, Adonay S. Nunes, Ilkay Yildiz Potter, Ram Kinker Mishra, Andrew Geronimo, Jamie L. Adams, Catherine Isroff, Jesse E. Wang, Ashkan Vaziri, Anne-Marie Wills, Alexander Pantelyat
pmc-12418861.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Highlights•Key speech features such as Total Voiced Time differentiated clinical conditions.•Elastic Net models reached 77% balanced accuracy across the 5 diagnostic classes.•Machine learning can extract key speech features in neurodegenerative diseases. Introduction

Neurodegenerative diseases, including PD, PSP, HD, and ALS, present significant challenges for both patients and healthcare providers due to their complexity and heterogeneity, with distinct motor, speech, and cognitive symptoms [1]. Speech analysis has gained attention as a tool for detecting and monitoring neurodegenerative diseases.

pmc-12506322.title: Aedes aegypti strain selected with Bacillus thuringiensis svar. israelensis larvicide for 50 generations remains susceptible and exhibited increased fitness
pmc-12506322.creator: Heverly Suzany Gouveia Menezes, Louise Helena Guimarães Oliveira, Ana Paula Araújo, Karine Silva Carvalho, Maria Helena Neves Lobo Silva-Filha
pmc-12506322.description: BackgroundBacillus thuringiensis serovar israelensis (Bti) was the first bacterial larvicide developed for dipteran control. Its insecticidal crystal, composed of protoxins such as Cry11Aa, Cry4Ba, Cry4Aa, and Cyt1Aa, exhibits a selective and complex mode of action and a low potential for resistance development.

pmc-12599731.title: Elective surgery during a global health crisis – point incidence of mortality and complications in a Portuguese hospital: A cohort study
pmc-12599731.creator: Ana Lídia Rouxinol-Dias, Diana Rodrigues, Leonardo Ferreira, Patrícia Martins Lima, Patrícia Ramos, Cláudia Camila Dias, Joana Berger-Estilita, Cristina Granja
pmc-12599731.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Elective surgeries are often restricted due to pandemics, resource shortages, natural disasters, and mass casualty events, which prioritize emergency care. During the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic, elective surgeries were significantly affected, with a global estimate of over 20,00,000 cancellations/wk.

pmc-12683355.title: Epidemiology and clinical features of alcoholic liver disease in Hainan Province, China
pmc-12683355.creator: Da-Ya Zhang, Da Li, Shi-Mei Huang, Chen Chen, Fan Zeng, Fei-Hu Bai
pmc-12683355.description: BACKGROUNDAlcohol can cause alcoholic fatty liver, alcoholic steatohepatitis, alcoholic liver cirrhosis (ALC), and hepatocellular carcinoma. China has become the second-largest country in the world in terms of alcohol consumption, lacking national epidemiological data on alcoholic liver disease (ALD).AIMTo understand the incidence and characteristics of ALD in Hainan Province of China.

pmc-12749167.title: Research on a precise positioning method of rapid excavation systems based on integrated navigation
pmc-12749167.creator: Hongda Zhu, Yuang Zhao, Yunlin Zhou, Zihan Jin, Yaqiang Wei, Sihai Zhao
pmc-12749167.description: As coal mine intelligentization advances, precise navigation for rapid excavation systems is critical for efficiency and safety. This study addresses several challenges, including GPS denial, a limited visual line-of-sight, and a lack of multiequipment collaboration in tunnels, by proposing an INS + Vision “mutual reference” collaborative positioning scheme. The method meets high-precision positioning requirements under complex working face conditions.

pmc-12975427.title: Influence of antiviral treatment in hepatitis C patients on metabolism and fibrosis process
pmc-12975427.creator: Malwina Jędrysik, Krzysztof Tomasiewicz, Beata Chełstowska, Magdalena Tudrujek-Zdunek, Filip M. Szymański
pmc-12975427.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13152999.title: The Interstellar Mapping And Acceleration Probe High Energy (IMAP-Hi) Neutral Atom Imager
pmc-13152999.creator: H O Funsten, F Allegrini, D B Reisenfeld, G Cardarelli, B C Carpenter, E R Christian, S Cortinas, S P Craft, F D Da Rocha, E R Dauson, A De Los Santos, G F Dunn, P A Fernandes, G Fletcher, K A Ford, J Ford, E G Geros, M Gkioulidou, G Grubbs, A A Guthrie, J J Hanley, D S Harvey, R L Hemphill, B D Hil
pmc-13152999.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The IMAP-Hi Energetic Neutral Atom (ENA) Imager on NASA’s Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe (IMAP) mission (McComas et al. 2018a, 2025) is designed to measure ENAs from the global interaction between the heliosphere and the local interstellar medium (LISM). These ENAs are initially plasma ions of solar wind origin that are neutralized by charge exchange with the cold neutral atoms of LISM that freely flow through the heliosphere-LISM interaction region.

pmc-13237991.title: Estimating fMRI timescale maps
pmc-13237991.creator: Gabriel Riegner, Samuel Davenport, Bradley Voytek, Armin Schwartzman
pmc-13237991.description: Brain activity unfolds over hierarchical timescales that reflect how brain regions integrate and process information, linking functional and structural organization. While timescale studies are prevalent, existing estimation methods rely on the restrictive assumption of exponentially decaying temporal autocorrelation and only provide point estimates without standard errors, limiting statistical inference.

pmc-13360545.title: From Passive to Active: Self‐Propelled Colloids in Coatings Formulation and Film Formation
pmc-13360545.creator: Karnika Singh, Jan Cammann, Luka Burduli, Edgar Espinosa Rodriguez, Franck D'Agosto, Muriel Lansalot, Ignacio Martin‐Fabiani
pmc-13360545.description: Coatings are widely used in protective and functional applications but are fundamentally limited by the passive nature of their formulation ingredients. This leads to a critical lack of control over the spatial distribution of ingredients and prevents the optimization of key functional properties. Here, we demonstrate the use of active, self‐propelled constituents in coatings formulations.

pmc-13579152.title: Targeting 3-mercaptopyruvate sulfurtransferase selectively eliminates colorectal cancer stem cells
pmc-13579152.creator: Kelly Ascenção, Olivia Oravecz, Csaba Szabo
pmc-13579152.description: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) contribute to therapeutic resistance, metastatic progression, and tumor recurrence, yet the metabolic pathways that sustain their survival remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify 3-mercaptopyruvate sulfurtransferase (3-MST), a hydrogen sulfide–producing enzyme encoded by MPST, as a metabolic dependency of colorectal CSCs.

pmc-13597710.title: Tracking the evolution of tuberculosis research priorities in Africa: a longitudinal bibliometric analysis from 2003–2023
pmc-13597710.creator: Olusesan Adeyemi Adelabu, Peter Ayodeji Idowu, Jolly Musoke
pmc-13597710.description: BackgroundMycobacterium tuberculosis is the primary causative agent of pulmonary tuberculosis and remains a major global public health concern, particularly in low- and lower-middle-income countries. Tuberculosis continues to be one of the leading causes of death from infectious diseases and is a significant contributor to mortality among both HIV-positive and HIV-negative populations in Africa.
